subject: Cannot install Bioconductor suite on RRO 3.2.2 in ubuntu?

messages.author: d59c8eab996a58a8
messages.subject: Cannot install Bioconductor suite on RRO 3.2.2 in ubuntu?
parts:
Hi,

I am new to RRO and am installing it on a fresh install of Ubuntu 15.4. Upon trying to install the bioconductor suit I get the following problem presented to me.


*terminal*
Type 'demo()' for some demos, 'help()' for on-line help, or
'help.start()' for an HTML browser interface to help.
Type 'q()' to quit R.

Revolution R Open 3.2.2
Default CRAN mirror snapshot taken on 2015-08-27
The enhanced R distribution from Revolution Analytics
Visit mran.revolutionanalytics.com/open for information
about additional features.

Multithreaded BLAS/LAPACK libraries detected. Using 2 cores for math algorithms.
> source("http://bioconductor.org/biocLite.R")
Installing package into ‘/home/david/R/x86_64-pc-linux-gnu-library/3.2’
(as ‘lib’ is unspecified)
sh: 1: curl: not found
sh: 1: curl: not found
Error in read.dcf(file = tmpf) : cannot open the connection
In addition: Warning message:
In read.dcf(file = tmpf) :
  cannot open compressed file '/tmp/RtmpefZ2r3/file333e67313170', probable reason 'No such file or directory'
*terminal*

I have normal connection to the internet. Am I requesting the pakage to the wrong repository?

If anyone has suggestions I would love to hear them

messages.author: 9ca0345d553844f2
messages.subject: Re: Cannot install Bioconductor suite on RRO 3.2.2 in ubuntu?
parts:
Hi David,

It seems as if the program 'curl' is currently not installed on your system.  Perhaps you could try to `apt-get install` it and try again.

Thanks,
Josée

messages.author: d59c8eab996a58a8
messages.subject: Re: Cannot install Bioconductor suite on RRO 3.2.2 in ubuntu?
parts:
Thank you!

That was it, in my mind curl stood for cran-url or something.

after installing curl by typing: "sudo apt-get install curl" I could install bioconductor.
